initialization_and_cleanup_obligations.description: Custom mainCRTStartup / WinMainCRTStartup must align RSP to 16-byte boundary before SSE2/AVX2 instructions.
Must invoke __security_init_cookie() and provide __security_check_cookie + __guard_check_icall_fptr when /GS and /guard:cf are retained with /NODEFAULTLIB.
Must define extern "C" int _fltused = 0x9875 for floating-point codegen under Windows x64 ABI.
Must supply freestanding memcpy, memset, and memcmp compiled with -fno-builtin so LTO does not emit unresolved UCRT symbol references.
Must walk .CRT$XCA through .CRT$XCZ or statically forbid non-trivial global constructors and thread_local variables.
Must drain D3D12 direct queue fence, release all COM pointers, destroy HWND, and call ExitProcess(exit_code) explicitly.

measurements.notes: Omitting ucrtbase.dll imports via /NODEFAULTLIB reduced empty_player from 10752 bytes to 6656 bytes (-4096 bytes), but naive /NODEFAULTLIB without linking vcruntime security-cookie/CFG stubs fails linker resolution for __security_cookie and __guard_check_icall_fptr when platform security mitigations (/GS, /guard:cf) are retained.

diagnostics.summary: lld-link error: undefined symbol: __security_check_cookie, __security_cookie, __guard_check_icall_fptr when /NODEFAULTLIB is enabled alongside /GS and /guard:cf without custom security support stubs.
diagnostics.preservation_statement: CRT elimination remains disabled by default (NW_ENABLE_CRT_ELIMINATION_EXPERIMENT=OFF); this record preserves the exact /NODEFAULTLIB obligations, byte measurements, and linker failure diagnostics without silently falling back or stripping security mitigations.
